compute_embedding_loss: compute cross-entropy loss for estimated embeddings given annotated vertices and ground truth mesh vertex IDs
initialize_embedding_loss: initialize an EmbeddingLoss instance from a Detectron2 config node with gauss sigma parameter
extract_vertex_embeddings: extract normalized vertex embeddings at interpolated points using bilinear interpolation weights
compute_fake_values: compute zero-valued fake loss tensors for meshes with no valid annotated points in the batch
compute_squared_distance_scores: compute unnormalized scores from squared Euclidean distance matrix between vertex and mesh embeddings
